title: Honey-roasted carrots
description: Tender carrots glazed with honey and thyme — a cosy winter main for vegetarian evenings.
steps: Peel the carrots and cut the large ones in half lengthwise.
Toss them with the olive oil, honey, crushed garlic, thyme, salt and pepper.
Spread on a baking tray and roast for 30–35 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and tender.
